english.title: Fail to keep a motor vehicle in gear except when stopped within the Mersey Tunnels
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[within the Mersey Tunnels, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL..),]_
(B)_[within the Mersey Tunnels' approaches and marshalling areas, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TUNNEL APPROACH OR MARSHALLING AREA..),]_

failed to keep the vehicle in gear, except when stopped
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(g) and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the driver of a vehicle within the Mersey Tunnels / approaches / marshalling areas
failed to keep the vehicle in gear except when stopped.
